narrative.intro: Black Construction Tutor Perini has $710M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. The company won 14 awards so far, with an average award size of $50.7M, and obligations are up 448.3% year over year. Annual history shows fluctuating obligations: FY21 $98.5M, FY22 $286M, FY23 $71.2M, FY24 $228M, FY25 $129M, and FY26 $710M. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction accounts for $703M of FY2026 obligations. New Multifamily Housing Construction (except For-Sale Builders) accounts for $7.2M of FY2026 obligations. The current totals are partial because FY2026 is fiscal year to date. The figures presented are contract obligations except for award-value entries in other tables when noted. This snapshot highlights that most FY2026 federal spending for Black Construction Tutor Perini is concentrated in one NAICS market and that the recent rise in obligations is sharp compared with previous fiscal years. Readers should treat FY2026 totals as incomplete for the full fiscal year.
